svg.aria-label: Experience. Senior Software Engineer at Frontier Semiconductor Bangladesh Ltd. (Jun 2025 – Present): Leading frontend development for a national-scale e-commerce platform, with full-stack TypeScript services behind it.; Software Engineer at Soft BD Ltd. (Aug 2023 – May 2025): Led development of national-scale payment infrastructure serving 26+ polytechnic institutions and the Bangladesh judiciary. Architected government security and SSO integration, resolved 250+ production bugs, and shipped enterprise payroll and CRM platforms.; Software Engineer, Intern at Fliqaindia (Apr 2023 – Aug 2023): Converted Figma designs into production React applications and owned GCP deployments with SEO optimisation.
